analysis:
This PR changes documentation only: docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head excerpts, lines 861-1713) and docs/provider/direct-mode.md (patch). No code, config or security control changed, so I found no regression or new attack surface.

direct-mode.md:
- Documents that a dev build (`darkbloom-dev`) uses `~/.darkbloom-dev` and its own default local port.
- Refreshes the date to 2026-10-14.
- The `local_token` / `local.json` 0600 handling and `DARKBLOOM_LOCAL_DIR` override are unchanged.
- Dev and prod now keep separate token and discovery files; this reduces cross-contamination and is not a threat-model gap.

cli-reference.md, claims for later passes to check against code (not verified here):
- The `darkbloom report` description: sudo reads the invoking user's auth_token via `AuthTokenStore.loadReadOnly` and writes nothing as root; device-wide devicecheck evidence is reduced to closed patterns; model names and load figures stay private in logs. Relevant to A-008 and T-058.
- The prefix-cache and SSD environment passthrough list. Relevant to T-041 / SEC-035: the 30-minute TTL, the `DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE` kill switch, and default-on for named models. These match the T-041 text and do not widen the at-rest surface.
- `DARKBLOOM_APP_ATTEST_WORKER_QUALIFICATION=1` is passed through only on an exact `1`, as an opt-in candidate. This is consistent with TB-011 (default-off).
- The unenroll and logout descriptions, and the fan-helper pins. These are consistent with the existing T-044 to T-047 and A-008 notes.

Cosmetic only: line 1503 has a malformed table row (`memory_reserve_gb` is missing a closing backtick and `|` cell).

Coverage limit: the cli-reference diff hunks were not supplied, only the head text, so I could not tell which lines changed.
